Hall of Fame Inducts Lee
<Seung-Yeop Lee:player#36987>, the great first baseman and consummate professional, was inducted into the KBO League Hall of Fame today.

At the induction ceremony, he grew misty-eyed as he recalled the highlights of his playing career: his first base hit, his first home run and -- humorously -- the first time he was thrown out at home plate.

Lee says he blew through his third base coach's stop sign. As he returned to the dugout, his manager simply glared at him. 

"His eyes just burned a hole right through me," Lee chuckled. "If looks could kill, I wouldn't be here today."

More often than not, Lee pleased his managers and coaches during a superb career.

His all-time numbers show <Lee:player#36987> compiled a .302 batting average and collected 2156 hits, 467 home runs and 1498 RBIs. In all, he played in 1906 games. <Lee:player#36987> retired from baseball in 2026.
